text: 从央行获得的数据，10月份企业新发放贷款加权平均利率约为2.9%，比上年同期低约0.2个百分点，贷款利率保持低位。（金融时报）
text_en: Data obtained from the central bank shows that in October, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was about 2.9%, about 0.2 percentage points lower than a year earlier, with loan rates remaining at low levels. (Financial Times)
